meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 智能体会自动安装 Vercel 命令行工具、配置访问密钥、把技能同步到所有容器并重启容器。之后你让它部署，它就直接用 Vercel 命令完成，不再需要你手动操作。
howto.when: 当你说要部署 Web 应用到 Vercel 时触发。若 OneCLI 未安装，会先提示运行 /init-onecli 再继续。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel。
say.note: 智能体会自动完成安装、配置并执行部署。

say.text: 部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 使用 vercel deploy --prod 命令推送。

say.text: 看看有哪些 Vercel 部署。
say.note: 智能体运行 vercel ls 列出部署列表。

howto.what_en: The agent automatically installs the Vercel CLI, configures credentials, syncs skills to all containers, and restarts them. After setup, it can deploy web apps to Vercel directly when asked, with no manual steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks the agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, the skill prompts the user to run /init-onecli before continuing.

say_en.note: Agent installs, configures, and runs the deployment.
Runs vercel ls to show deployments.
